title: Section 13B HMA — Divorce by mutual consent

content.overview: Section 13B permits divorce by mutual consent where both parties have been living separately for a period of one year or more, have not been able to live together, and have mutually agreed that the marriage should be dissolved; the court may, after the statutory cooling-off and on being satisfied, grant a decree.
content.study: File a joint petition; after presentation there is ordinarily a six-month cooling-off before the second motion, which must be completed within eighteen months of the first petition unless waived by the court in appropriate cases. Consent must continue until the decree; either party may withdraw consent before the decree. Contrast with contested divorce under section 13 and link to sections 24 and 25 for interim and permanent financial relief.
